events.title: 75 Full Game Keys Up For Grabs. See You At Next Fest Oct 2026!
events.summary: 🎉 Crack a Pack is joining Steam Next Fest!We're excited to announce that Crack a Pack will be part of Steam Next Fest, October 19–26! We'll also have new updates coming before the event. We're also preparing 75 Full Game Keys for Players and Creators!🎁 Win Keys to the Full Game!Collect money from your cards on the board in the demo to get code drops.
